Description: This term set contains the complete list of vendors, suppliers, contractors, integrators, and service providers that support Engineering operations across the organization. It centralizes vendor naming for consistent metadata tagging, document classification, contract management, equipment records, project documentation, and operational workflows. The vocabulary includes companies related to industrial automation, food-processing equipment, construction, mechanical services, packaging machinery, robotics, HVAC, electrical systems, safety systems, material handling, and other technical services used by Engineering teams. This term set enables standardized tagging across SharePoint libraries and enhances search, filtering, and reporting for all Engineering-related vendor documentation.
